data.rationale: The proposal matches the true workflow's steps, order and parameters (country, capital) and the same note format. It adds a time zone to the note and says the capital is read from the infobox, though the capital is a parameter. Population, languages, currency and time are extracted values, so automation is mostly feasible, with only slight ambiguity over the tz suffix and the capital's source.
